Stock market news | LG Electronics Inc to sell 2% stake in LG Electronics India

LG Electronics Inc plans to sell up to 2% of its total equity share capital in LG Electronics India through a block deal. The aggregate deal value is worth up to ₹2,320.5 crore at a floor price of ₹1,709.30 per share.
